hypothesis: PRE-REGISTERED: 5-minute opening range breakout (Zarattini & Aziz 2023, 'Can Day Trading Really Be Profitable?', SSRN 4416622; QQQ 2016-2023). Rules (all fixed now): session = weekday with RTH bars; first 5-min bar = 1m bars 09:30-09:34 NY (all 5 must exist, else skip day). Direction = long if its close > its open, short if close < open, no trade if equal. Entry = open of the 09:35 1m bar. Stop = low of the first 5-min bar for longs, high for shorts; R = |entry - stop|; skip if R <= 0. Target = entry +/- 10R. Exit at stop, target, or the close of the last bar at or before 15:59, whichever comes first; if one 1m bar touches both stop and target count the stop; a bar that gaps past the stop fills at its open. One trade per day, no filters, no sizing. Cost = 2 bp of entry round trip, deducted in R. Unit = net R per trade. Data: DECISIVE = NQ 1m 2020-2025 (hindsight-finance, closest to QQQ) ex roll weeks (roll_excluded from gapfade-H0012); corroboration = SPY 1m RTH 2019-01..2025-07 (Ascensao) and SPXUSD 1m 2010-2018 (FutureSharks). PASS only if all hold: NQ net mean R > 0 with one-sided t >= z(0.05/N) at N=198; SPY net mean R > 0; SPXUSD gross mean R > 0. Reported, not decisive: post-publication NQ subsample 2023-05 onward, per-year table, bootstrap p5 (10k iid, seed 0), win rate, trades/yr, and a future-truncation test (direction, entry, stop decided with bars after 09:35 removed).

Prop needs about +0.28R/trade at 3/day; at 1/day it needs more. RESULT 2026-10-06 (result fields = NQ ex-roll net mean R and 10k iid bootstrap p5, seed 0): N=198 bar z 3.4781. hypothesis: PRE-REGISTERED: intraday VWAP trend (Zarattini & Aziz 2023, 'Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP): The Holy Grail for Day Trading Systems', SSRN 4631351; QQQ 2018-2023). Rules (all fixed now): session = weekday with RTH bars 09:30-15:59 NY; session VWAP from 09:30 = cumsum(typical price (h+l+c)/3 x volume)/cumsum(volume), updated at each 1m bar close using only bars up to and including that bar. At each bar close from 09:30 through 15:58: desired position = +1 if close > VWAP, -1 if close < VWAP, unchanged if equal (flat before the first non-equal signal). Position changes execute at the NEXT bar's open. Flat at the 15:59 bar close. No stops, no targets, no filters, size 1 contract / 1x notional. Cost per unit traded (a flip = 2 units, an open or close = 1): NQ 0.375 index pt (1 tick slippage + about $4.50 commission per round trip / 2); SPY 0.5 bp of price. Unit = net daily return in bp of notional (sum of the day's P&L / that day's first entry price). Data: DECISIVE = NQ 1m 2020-09..2025-11 (hindsight-finance) ex roll weeks (roll_excluded from gapfade-H0012), RTH bars only, volume from that file; corroboration = SPY 1m RTH 2019-01..2025-07 (Ascensao, volume column). PASS only if both hold: NQ net daily mean > 0 with one-sided t >= z(0.05/N) at N=199; SPY net daily mean > 0. Reported, not decisive: gross, average units traded per day, annualized Sharpe, max drawdown, worst day, per-year table, bootstrap p5 (10k iid, seed 0), NQ post-publication subsample 2023-11 onward, cost x2 sensitivity, and a future-truncation test (the position held during each bar does not change when all later bars are removed).
